_evidence: 0x004083f2 (esi = a car record of the 22-record, 0x41c-stride array at 0x0066fef0; fixed here at record 1 = 0x0067030c so a list entry 0x41c hits the cmp ebx,esi / je exit) starts at byte [esi+0x7d] (0x00670389) into the u16 list at 0x0066fe3c and reads words from list+[+0x7d]+2 on, step 2. 0x4091b5 builds that list from the 22 record offsets k*0x41c with 0xffff terminators and 0x408f42 stores the entry's byte offset 2*i (i 0..21) in +0x7d, so +0x7d is even 0..42 and every word is an offset k*0x41c (k 0..21) or a negative terminator (or ax,ax / js exit). For each entry the record's byte +0x7a bit 7 (0x0066ff6a + k*0x41c) loops back, else word +0x68 of that record minus esi's +0x68 (0x0066ff58 + k*0x41c) is the clc result. All fields are bounded to the 22 records, so nothing reads outside the array.
